statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH (yellow); Tail remains below the blocking threshold while Stress is extreme.
recommendation: Current evidence supports WATCH-level Tail: delayed NQ set a deeper session low but then rebounded meaningfully, while elevated Treasury yields, oil and the approaching PPI window keep market stress high.
headline: WATCH Tail after deeper NQ low and rebound ahead of PPI
body: Delayed September NQ is 29,412.00, 36.75 points below prior settlement after trading from 29,359.25 to 29,508.25. The roughly 53-point rebound from the low shows mean reversion remains present. The U.S. 10-year yield near 4.85% and Brent above $100 keep the macro backdrop stressed before PPI.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock-hours, published Tail peaked at 43% during the September 9 U.S. selloff at 14:00 UTC, then fell into the high teens and low twenties as two-way trade returned. The September 9 12:00 UTC slot has no published assessment and remains unavailable.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours concentrate risk around 12:30 UTC PPI and claims, the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open and 14:00 UTC home sales. Oracle reports after the close, while Friday CPI keeps overnight Stress extreme. Tail escalation remains conditional on observed persistent extension or failed retracements.

forecast.analysis: Delayed September NQ is 29,412.00 after setting a 29,359.25 session low and rebounding about 53 points. The deeper low keeps Tail in WATCH, while the rebound shows meaningful mean reversion remains present.
drivers: New session low followed by a roughly 53-point rebound

forecast.analysis: If NQ continues rotating away from the overnight low, Tail remains in WATCH rather than escalating. A fresh low with only shallow rebounds would be the relevant warning before the data window.
drivers: PPI and claims are approaching at 12:30 UTC

forecast.analysis: PPI and weekly claims arrive at 12:30 UTC. This forecast keeps Tail at the top of WATCH; escalation above the band would require persistent post-release extension or failed retracements.
The first post-PPI hour overlaps the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open. Tail stays in WATCH unless an initial data impulse survives pullbacks and repeatedly extends through the opening auction.
Existing-home sales at 14:00 UTC add a second data checkpoint. Tail remains conditional on whether the PPI/open move holds near an extreme and defeats meaningful retracements.
By this hour, the first full post-open path should be clearer. Tail eases slightly if two-way rotation appears; repeated extension after failed pullbacks would keep the WATCH state elevated.
With the main U.S. data window behind, conditional Tail declines if NQ rotates away from session extremes. Oil and yields can keep Stress high even without a pathological price path.
drivers: Oil and Treasury yields remain macro stressors

forecast.analysis: Midday liquidity can magnify moves, but Tail stays in WATCH only if directional pressure remains efficient. Deeper countertrend swings would argue for continued mean reversion.
Late-morning U.S. trade is a persistence check. A market that repeatedly revisits the range interior keeps Tail near the WATCH boundary; extreme-holding would sustain concern.
Absent renewed one-way extension, Tail falls back into the low band. Stress remains elevated because the oil and rates backdrop can still produce large but reversible moves.
The U.S. close approaches with Oracle results due after the bell. The scheduled catalyst raises Stress, while Tail remains low unless index-level technology repricing becomes persistent.
drivers: Oracle results scheduled after the close

forecast.analysis: Oracle's earnings call is scheduled for 21:00 UTC. WATCH-level Tail here is conditional on a broad, persistent Nasdaq repricing; an isolated stock reaction would not establish mean-reversion failure.
drivers: Oracle fiscal Q1 earnings call at 21:00 UTC

forecast.analysis: If an after-hours technology impulse persists across megacaps and NQ with shallow pullbacks, WATCH remains justified. A contained Oracle reaction would leave Tail lower despite high Stress.
drivers: Retracement depth after the earnings catalyst

forecast.analysis: As after-hours price discovery matures, Tail stays near the WATCH boundary only if directional spillover remains broad. Fading or two-way trade would reduce path risk.
The overnight transition favors a lower Tail baseline if U.S. after-hours moves are absorbed. Friday CPI still keeps Stress elevated without counting an unobserved release path as fact.
drivers: Friday CPI remains a scheduled risk checkpoint

forecast.analysis: Early Asian trade is expected to carry high macro Stress but low Tail unless a new directional impulse holds near extremes and suppresses retracements.
Tail remains low if Asian price discovery is two-way. A synchronized move in NQ, yields and oil would be the condition for renewed WATCH-level path risk.
The Asia-to-Europe handoff remains a structure checkpoint. Meaningful reversals or range rotation keep Tail low even while CPI-related Stress stays extreme.
European liquidity begins to build while CPI is still hours away. WATCH-level Tail is conditional on persistent directional efficiency, not on the scheduled inflation release itself.
As Europe becomes active, macro sensitivity increases. Tail remains in WATCH only if NQ develops shallow pullbacks or repeated extension; event anticipation mainly sustains Stress.
The approach to U.S. CPI can widen ranges and reduce liquidity. Tail remains below the blocking threshold unless price structure becomes persistently one-way before the release.
With CPI closer, WATCH reflects conditional path risk rather than an assumed data outcome. Fresh extreme-holding or failed retracements would be the evidence needed for escalation.
The pre-CPI window can sustain high Stress and wider ranges. Tail remains WATCH-level unless independent live evidence shows repeated extension with weak mean reversion.

Three and a half hours before CPI, conditional Tail reaches the top of WATCH. The release outcome is still unknown; any move above this band would require observed one-way structure, not event importance alone.

forecastDetail.comment: Observed NQ made a deeper session low near 29,359 before rebounding to about 29,412; WATCH reflects low-area pressure without confirmed failed mean reversion.
If range rotation continues, Tail stays in WATCH; a fresh low with shallow rebounds would be the escalation signal before the data window.
PPI and claims arrive at 12:30 UTC; Tail remains capped at WATCH unless the post-release path becomes persistently one-way.
The 13:30 UTC cash open tests whether any data impulse survives pullbacks; repeated extension would be the relevant Tail evidence.
Existing-home sales at 14:00 UTC add another checkpoint; Tail depends on persistent post-PPI/open continuation, not the release itself.
The first full post-open hour should distinguish rotation from repeated extension; forecast Tail eases slightly if meaningful retracements return.
